title: Persistent open flat loci covering the limit of a supplied approximation
statement: Let R and S be commutative rings and let R to S be a ring map. Let M be an S-module. Let Λ be a nonempty directed preorder and let A,B:Λ to CommRing and D:Λ to AddCommGrp be functors [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Give D_i a B_i-module structure for every i. Suppose η:A to B, π:A to const(R), κ:B to const(S), and ν:D to const(M) are natural transformations. Assume R,S,M with these coprojections are colimits, η_i followed by κ_i equals π_i followed by R to S, every D transition is semilinear with respect to its B transition, and ν_i(bx)=κ_i(b)ν_i(x). Suppose each A_i is a finite-type integer algebra and each B_i is finite type over A_i [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], with D_i finite over B_i [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. For i≤j assume a ring isomorphism B_i tensor_(A_i) A_j to B_j sending b tensor a to B(i≤j)(b)η_j(a), and a B_j-linear isomorphism B_j tensor_(B_i) D_i to D_j sending b tensor x to b D(i≤j)(x). At each i suppose also a ring isomorphism B_i tensor_(A_i) R to S sending b tensor r to κ_i(b)r, and an S-linear isomorphism S tensor_(B_i) D_i to M sending s tensor x to sν_i(x). The algebra structures in these tensors are induced by η, π, κ and the transitions. If M, restricted along R to S, is flat over R [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], then there are open subsets U_i of Spec(B_i) [def-weil-affine-spectrum] such that: every q in U_i has D_i localized at q flat over A_i with the restricted module action; the inverse image of U_i under Spec(B_j) to Spec(B_i) lies in U_j whenever i≤j; and for every prime q of S there is i whose contraction κ_i^(-1)(q) lies in U_i. This concerns only local flatness and persistence in the supplied diagram, and asserts neither a globally flat stage nor an existential model comparison. Localization at q means LocalizedModule of the complement of q [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime].

proof.text: Define U_i as the full flat locus of D_i localized at primes of B_i, restricted along η_i. Finite type over Z makes A_i Noetherian; finite type over A_i makes B_i Noetherian. Convert finite type of B_i to finite presentation and finiteness of D_i to finite presentation. The private proved module-action comparison localized_restrict_eq identifies the canonical localization action with Module.compHom. Apply Module.isOpen_setOf_flat_localizedModule to get openness. Membership supplies the flatness clause by definition.

For i<=j, install the algebra structures from η and the transition maps. Naturality of η proves the two scalar towers. Tensor symmetry turns the supplied B_i tensor_(A_i) A_j ring equivalence into an A_j-algebra equivalence. Its pure-tensor formula exhibits the square as Algebra.IsPushout. Apply Module.Flat.localizedModule_of_isPushout with the supplied module tensor equivalence. The proved module-action comparison rewrites both localized flatness assertions into membership of U_i and U_j; hence the inverse image of U_i lies in U_j.

For each prime q of S apply exists_flat_finiteType_approximation_point to the supplied approximation and hflat. Its stage is a member of U_i by definition, giving the cover. Return the full flat loci with their openness, flatness, persistence and cover proofs.

proof_origin.place: Tag 02JO (1), first two paragraphs. Openness and persistence proved using the supplied tensor comparisons; only pointwise eventual flatness remains split.

theorem exists_flat_finiteType_approximation_loci
    (R S : Type u) (M : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module S M]
    {Λ : Type u} [Preorder Λ] [Nonempty Λ] [IsDirected Λ (· ≤ ·)]
    (A B : Λ ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (η : A ⟶ B)
      (π : A ⟶ (Functor.const Λ).obj (CommRingCat.of R))
      (κ : B ⟶ (Functor.const Λ).obj (CommRingCat.of S))
      (D : Λ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{v})
      (ν : D ⟶ (Functor.const Λ).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of M))
    [∀ i : Λ, Module (B.obj i) (D.obj i)]
    (hmodel :
      -- (1) the three colimits, compatible with `R → S` and the module actions
      Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk (CommRingCat.of R) π)) ∧
      Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk (CommRingCat.of S) κ)) ∧
      Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk (AddCommGrpCat.of M) ν)) ∧
      (∀ i, η.app i ≫ κ.app i = π.app i ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)) ∧
      (∀ (i j : Λ) (h : i ≤ j) (y : B.obj i) (x : D.obj i),
        (D.map (homOfLE h)).hom (y • x) =
          (B.map (homOfLE h)).hom y • (D.map (homOfLE h)).hom x) ∧
      (∀ i (y : B.obj i) (x : D.obj i),
        (@AddCommGrpCat.Hom.hom _ (AddCommGrpCat.of M) (ν.app i)) (y • x) =
          (@CommRingCat.Hom.hom _ (CommRingCat.of S) (κ.app i)) y •
            (@AddCommGrpCat.Hom.hom _ (AddCommGrpCat.of M) (ν.app i)) x) ∧
      -- (2) finiteness of the stages
      (∀ i, Algebra.FiniteType ℤ (A.obj i)) ∧
      (∀ i, letI := (η.app i).hom.toAlgebra; Algebra.FiniteType (A.obj i) (B.obj i)) ∧
      (∀ i, Module.Finite (B.obj i) (D.obj i)) ∧
      -- (3) transition base changes
      (∀ (i j : Λ) (h : i ≤ j),
        letI := (η.app i).hom.toAlgebra
        letI := (A.map (homOfLE h)).hom.toAlgebra
        ∃ e : B.obj i ⊗[A.obj i] A.obj j ≃+* B.obj j,
          ∀ (x : B.obj i) (y : A.obj j),
            e (x ⊗ₜ[A.obj i] y) = (B.map (homOfLE h)).hom x * (η.app j).hom y) ∧
      (∀ (i j : Λ) (h : i ≤ j),
        letI := (B.map (homOfLE h)).hom.toAlgebra
        ∃ e : B.obj j ⊗[B.obj i] D.obj i ≃ₗ[B.obj j] D.obj j,
          ∀ (y : B.obj j) (x : D.obj i),
            e (y ⊗ₜ[B.obj i] x) = y • (D.map (homOfLE h)).hom x) ∧
      -- (4) base changes to the limit
      (∀ i,
        letI := (η.app i).hom.toAlgebra
        letI := (@CommRingCat.Hom.hom _ (CommRingCat.of R) (π.app i)).toAlgebra
        ∃ e : B.obj i ⊗[A.obj i] R ≃+* S,
          ∀ (x : B.obj i) (y : R),
            e (x ⊗ₜ[A.obj i] y) =
              (@CommRingCat.Hom.hom _ (CommRingCat.of S) (κ.app i)) x * algebraMap R S y) ∧
      (∀ i,
        letI := (@CommRingCat.Hom.hom _ (CommRingCat.of S) (κ.app i)).toAlgebra
        ∃ e : S ⊗[B.obj i] D.obj i ≃ₗ[S] M,
          ∀ (y : S) (x : D.obj i),
            e (y ⊗ₜ[B.obj i] x) = y • (@AddCommGrpCat.Hom.hom _ (AddCommGrpCat.of M) (ν.app i)) x))
    (hflat : letI : Module R M := Module.compHom M (algebraMap R S)
      Module.Flat R M) :
    ∃ U : (i : Λ) → Set (PrimeSpectrum (B.obj i)),
      (∀ i, IsOpen (U i)) ∧
      (∀ i (q : PrimeSpectrum (B.obj i)), q ∈ U i →
        letI : Module (A.obj i) (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl (D.obj i)) :=
          Module.compHom _ (η.app i).hom
        Module.Flat (A.obj i) (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl (D.obj i))) ∧
      (∀ (i j : Λ) (h : i ≤ j),
        PrimeSpectrum.comap (B.map (homOfLE h)).hom ⁻¹' U i ⊆ U j) ∧
      (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum S, ∃ i, PrimeSpectrum.comap (κ.app i).hom q ∈ U i)
